title: Bounded narrative-state compilation and defeasible continuation ranking
independentExamples: A repaired nonce vehicle followed by a continuation that operates the same vehicle
A completed nonce ritual followed by a declaratively supported social consequence
A negative state assertion contrasted with an otherwise lexically similar positive assertion
outputTypes: selected candidate identifier or explicit UNKNOWN
preconditions: one to sixty-four validated narrative events
two to thirty-two uniquely identified candidate frames
at most sixteen providers and sixty-four support records per provider candidate
invariants: candidate text and KB content remain inert strings
candidate order is never a tie breaker
no candidate identifier, source row, expected answer, benchmark identifier, or exact sentence controls core flow
provider claims are defeasible evidence and retain source references
the selected candidate must exceed the runner-up by the declared minimum margin
uncertaintySemantics: DEFEASIBLE for a margin-qualified ranking; UNKNOWN for a tie or insufficient margin; UNPARSED for an invalid semantic payload
proofBehavior: Returns every feature value, weight, contribution, provenance reference, final margin, and provider-evidence count
kbMigration: No existing package schema changes. ATOMIC exposes an optional typed semantic-evidence interface; existing ask and package validation behavior remains compatible.
